lines.primary: Charlemagne est le grand roi des Francs.
lines.hanzi: 查理曼是法兰克人的大王。
lines.english: Charlemagne is the great king of the Franks.

lines.primary: Il veut rentrer en France avec son armée.
lines.english: He wants to go back to France with his army.

lines.primary: Son neveu Roland garde les montagnes.
lines.hanzi: 他的外甥罗兰守着群山。
lines.english: His nephew Roland guards the mountains.

lines.primary: Roland a une épée très célèbre.
lines.hanzi: 罗兰有一把很有名的剑。
lines.english: Roland has a very famous sword.

lines.primary: Un jour, des ennemis arrivent dans la vallée.
lines.hanzi: 有一天，敌人来到了山谷。
lines.english: One day, enemies arrive in the valley.
There are very many of them.

lines.primary: Son ami Olivier lui dit : « Sonne du cor ! »
lines.hanzi: 他的朋友奥利维耶对他说：“吹号角吧！”
lines.english: His friend Olivier says to him: “Blow your horn!”

lines.hanzi: 罗兰回答：“不，还不到时候。”

lines.primary: Le combat est long et dur.
lines.english: The fight is long and hard.

lines.primary: À la fin, Roland sonne du cor.
lines.english: In the end, Roland blows his horn.

lines.primary: Le son voyage jusqu’au roi, très loin.
lines.hanzi: 号角声一直传到很远很远的国王那里。
lines.english: The sound travels to the king, far away.

lines.primary: Charlemagne revient, mais il est trop tard.
lines.hanzi: 查理曼赶回来了，可是已经太晚了。
lines.english: Charlemagne comes back, but it is too late.

lines.primary: Le roi pleure son neveu et ses amis.
lines.hanzi: 国王为他的外甥和朋友们哭泣。
lines.english: The king weeps for his nephew and his friends.

synopsis: Roland waits too long to sound his horn at Roncevaux.
